test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **"in".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The phrase** "the unique female way in which she sees her world" makes the most sense in this context.
 
• The preposition** "in" **is used here to describe the manner or method of how she perceives her world.

The **correct sentence** is: '*I would uncover the story that lay invisible between the lines of the men's exploits. Better still, I would have one of them tell it herself, with all her joys and doubts, her struggles and her triumphs, her heartbreaks, her achievements, the unique female way **in** which she sees her world and her place in it. And who could be (4) ______ for this than Panchaali? It is her life, her voice, her questions, and her vision that I invite you (5) ______ 'The Palace of Illusions'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's break down the other options:
 
 
• **"Though"** - This word is a conjunction used to introduce a contrast or contradiction. It does not fit in this sentence as there is no contrast being made.
 
• **"Through" **- This preposition is used to describe movement within something, not a method or manner.
 
• **"By" -** This preposition can be used to denote the means or manner of an action, but in this case it does not fit as naturally as "in" to describe the way she sees her world.
